scope: Forty-six mid/late-paper logical-consequence sites: 44 ordinary inference markers and two causal-collision phrases.
choice: Map 26 lower tedy, 17 upper Tedy and one lower teda to zato/Zato; recast two adjacent zato že collisions with tym samym.
motivation: Every site is logical consequence. The two phrase recasts preserve result meaning without producing malformed 'zato ... zato že' sequences.
alternatives_rejected: A blind token replacement would create duplicated zato at the two causal-conjunction sites.
Togda would introduce temporal meaning absent from these passages.
Retaining tedy/teda would preserve the unresolved mixed connective layer.

evidence.semantic_review: All 46 sites were independently classified as logical consequence; zero equivalence, conditional apodosis, temporal or filler uses occur in this tranche.
evidence.official_policy: EDIT-0044 established zato as the type-1 cross-family result marker and tym samym for guarded anaphoric result recasts.
evidence.source_alignment: German uses logical also/so/folglich or causal da constructions at the selected sites.

results.residual_scope: All residual sites are confined to base-paper lines 23008-25082.

validation.coverage: Forty-four exact ordinal tokens plus two exact guarded phrases.
validation.writer_correction: Writer QA corrected two stale capitalization labels at lines 19733 and 19895 before application; both output as sentence-case Zato.
validation.postcondition: Project connective residue is exactly 84 and confined to the late-paper block.
validation.structure: Ordered TeX controls, braces, math delimiters, labels/refs/cites and line counts invariant.
validation.reproducibility: Frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply.
